rainy_night.evidence: Rain streaks on the shelter glass, dark sky, saturated pavement and sharp wet-road reflections.

final_bus_departing.evidence: The bus rear and tire spray recede to the right; the shelter board reads Last Service 23:42 and Then no further buses tonight.

one_adult_stranded.evidence: One adult stands alone beside the stop while the bus has left the boarding point; no other foreground person appears.

wet_documents_held.evidence: The person grips several limp, marked paper sheets at hip height; their exposed edges and surface appear damp.

dejection_legible.evidence: Dropped shoulders and a still stance support disappointment, but the face is a small side profile and its expression reads subdued more than unmistakably devastated.

hurried_passerby_snapshot.evidence: The image has a human-height street viewpoint, yet the level horizon, clean left-right staging and cinematic lighting feel more composed than a rushed passing snapshot.

single_frame_event_and_affect.evidence: The missed bus and stranded person are clear together; emotional specificity is weaker at normal viewing size.

summary: Strong literal event, environment and object fidelity; the main remaining weakness is expressive and camera-behavior fidelity. One image call was authorized and used, with no retry.
